## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      10 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 17, 2026 - Aug 20, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _JesusIsKing2323_, Aug 19, 2026, 1/5: "I have been using this app for free for 10 years and now you can no longer set macros. I will never use this again. It’s far too expensive just to pay for it just to track protein, fats and carbs separately. The only thing you can do is enter your foods and set calories. Useless."
            2. _JeffBinNC_, Aug 20, 2026, 2/5: "The new update is totally unusable. What’s worse is with all the backlash the company refuses to acknowledge to feedback or make changes. Will definitely be switching when my plan ends. And oh by the way you can never cancel and get any refund for the premium version."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Ads pressure.**
      3 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Aug 17, 2026 - Aug 20, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Adriana04_, Aug 20, 2026, 1/5: "I paid for premium for one year and it will be the last year I use it. First, I am still getting ads! Even ads asking me to upgrade to premium when I already pay for premium! Second, barcode feature is now useless. Ever since they removed it from free users, guess who is updating the database now? No one. When I scan foods, it goes into some random listing and not the actual food I bought. They really ruined their database with that one. Other premium features are useless and not worth paying for. And lastly, who redesigned the app??! Do they even use the app? It’s cluttered and horrible. It’s been fine for so many years, why make it worse? I canceled my subscription. It’s very disappointing and not something worth paying for."
            2. _Kodefuguru_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "MyFitnessPal’s ads on AMC+ are substantially louder than the shows and every other commercial. It is extremely irritating to have to grab the remote and mute the television every time one comes on. Congratulations: your advertising was effective. It persuaded me to download the app—specifically so I could give it one star."
            3. _Zygy_zygyzyg_, Aug 17, 2026, 2/5: "Clunky ui, missing buttons and more ads"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      7 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 18, 2026 - Aug 19, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _ickyrr_, Aug 18, 2026, 1/5: "The new update is so awful and there are so many bugs to fix, the app takes a full 30 seconds to even start working and scroll on it to look to your step progress."
            2. _how will he get a kiz kizz_, Aug 18, 2026, 1/5: "i’ve used this app for 6 years now, and each year, this app gets worse everything is stuck behind a paywall now and is almost unusable. although it’s the most popular app, i’d much rather use any other, newer app, due to the sheer amount of paywalls this app has. this app used to be so much more streamlined and user-friendly but has gone down the drain in recent years"
            3. _Jen,seeking resolution_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible navigation, continually have Mondays entries end up on the following Sunday, no longer is there mass delete, various editing functions gone, way more clicks to add and delete, hideous UI and UX, glitchy. Did anyone bother to even do a feature gap analysis before deploying this junk that has had nothing but terrible reviews none of which have they remedied or even addressed? Boycot these people"
<!--/ir-theme-->
